templates.title: Enterprise application shell
templates.useWhen: A multi-surface desktop or web tool needs stable project/task/target context.
templates.doNotUseWhen: A focused one-page workflow does not need persistent navigation.

templates.title: Task detail with evidence
templates.useWhen: A team tracks owner, status, dependencies, agent sessions, artifacts and acceptance.
templates.doNotUseWhen: The item is a short personal reminder.

templates.title: Data workspace
templates.useWhen: A user explores connections, schemas, queries, plans and result grids.
templates.doNotUseWhen: A simple read-only table is sufficient.

templates.title: Review and execute
templates.useWhen: A reversible or risky operation needs target, diff, validation, execution and readback evidence.
templates.doNotUseWhen: The action is a safe idempotent read.

templates.title: Design library workspace
templates.useWhen: A team browses tokens, components, icons, templates, provenance and consumer adoption.
templates.doNotUseWhen: Only a one-off mockup is being produced.

templates.title: Agent-assisted kit publication
templates.useWhen: An agent proposes, previews, executes and verifies a reviewed design-system release.
templates.doNotUseWhen: A release lacks repository binding, required review or evidence.
